_readme: Har setting yahan se badalti hai. Milestone 1 mein Gemini/discovery/ASR band hain (wo M2 mein aayenge).

canvas._note: Final video ka size aur fps.

clip._note: Har moment ka preferred_clip_sec follow hota hai (normally 3-9s). Koi hard 6s cap nahi. Image/still 10-20s.

align._note: script_cue_exact ko SRT/script line se match karne ke thresholds (handoff Stage 2).

dialogue._note: DIALOGUE locator ke subtitle-match thresholds (handoff Stage 4). M1 mein sirf inhi se accept hota hai — koi Gemini nahi.

qa._note: Local quality checks. blackFrameRatio = kitni frames tak kaali/froze ho to reject.
qa._dupNote: warn = duplicate sirf report flag (clip final mein rahegi). holdout = purana behavior.

render._note: allowSilent=false => production ko voiceover audio zaroori (missing audio = fail, misleading DONE nahi). Test harness true set karta hai.
render._timebaseNote: Voiceover audio hi project ki asli lambai hai. SRT 5s tak pehle ruk jaye to last visual audio end tak extend hota hai (audioLeadExtendMaxSeconds); voiceover kabhi cut nahi hoti. Bada farak run rokta hai kyunki narration map missing ho sakta hai.
render._overlayNote: Research-pack overlay_text sirf planning hint hai, final video ka title nahi. Default false par frame clean render hota hai. Future Editor text/template action hi ise explicit true/opt-in karega.

tools._note: Windows par PATH mein na ho to poora path daalo. Khaali = PATH se dhoondo. jsRuntime khaali = auto (Deno 2.3+ prefer, warna Node 22+); ya 'deno' / 'deno:C:\\path\\deno.exe' / 'node'.

concurrency._note: Ek sath kitne moments process hon. Dheema laptop ho to 1 kar do.

acquire._note: Source bank: chhoti/reused sources ek baar poori aati hain (<=720p), phir sab clips local se cut. Isse 53 downloads ~13 ho jaate hain.
acquire._varietyNote: Jab bahut se beats bina exact clip ke hon, to itne tak same-scope sources laate hain taaki context footage mein variety rahe (ek episode loop na lage).
acquire._capNote: fullDownloadMaxSeconds = variety/fallback ke liye. fullDownloadHardMaxSeconds = jab source kai moments ko chahiye (multi-use) — 40 min tak poori source laana range-per-moment se sasta aur zyada reliable hai.
acquire._rangeNote: Isse lambi source par per-moment range download bharosemand nahi (asli run: 300s timeout), isliye use ek moment ke liye bhi POORI laate hain. Range fail ho to bhi poori source se recovery hoti hai.

download._note: Per-moment range download (jab source bank use na ho).

shots._note: Ek narration beat ko chhote shots mein todna. Koi lamba frozen frame nahi.
shots._hardNote: HARD CAP: koi bhi visual (clip/still/graphic) itne second se zyada screen par nahi rahega.

fallback._note: Zero-card ladder. keyframes = pehle se downloaded approved source se nikale gaye frames (free, scope-correct).
fallback._ctxNote: Exact clip na ho to usi approved source se CHALTA HUA context clip (still se behtar). Source already downloaded hota hai.

output._note: production final.mp4 mein diagnostic cards NAHI. review.mp4 (debug) mein dikhte hain.
